# Travelaxis

> Professional visa documentation consultancy, UAE company formation, business setup in Dubai, trade licensing, and related government services. Serves Pakistani nationals with UAE document attestation and visa documentation for the UK, Canada, and Australia, alongside UAE-focused services. Based in Al Qusais, Dubai, UAE. Content is general information, not legal advice. Travelaxis is a documentation and consultancy service — it does not issue visas or licenses, arrange sponsorship or jobs, guarantee approval, or provide regulated immigration/PR consulting (e.g. Canada Express Entry/PNP, Australia skilled-visa assessment); applications are submitted through the relevant country's official government channels.

- [Umrah services](https://travelaxis.me/services/umrah-services/) — Umrah visa processing, flight booking, hotel accommodation, and group travel coordination
- [UAE document attestation from Pakistan](https://travelaxis.me/services/attestation/) — degree, marriage, birth, and experience certificate attestation covering the HEC/IBCC, MOFA, UAE Embassy, and MOFAIC chain
- [UK visa from Pakistan](https://travelaxis.me/services/uk-visa-from-pakistan/) — Skilled Worker, Student, Visit, and Family/Spouse visa documentation
- [Canada visa from Pakistan](https://travelaxis.me/services/canada-visa-from-pakistan/) — study permit, work permit, visit visa, and spouse open work permit documentation (not Express Entry/PNP filing, which requires a CICC-licensed consultant)
- [Australia visa from Pakistan](https://travelaxis.me/services/australia-visa-from-pakistan/) — Visitor, Student, and Partner/Family visa documentation (not skilled-visa points assessment, which requires a MARA-registered agent)
- [Services for clients in Pakistan](https://travelaxis.me/pakistan/) — hub linking attestation, UK/Canada/Australia visas, Umrah, and Pakistan-specific sections of our UAE guides
